title: 20000 mAh 65 W USB-C power bank
bullets: 20000 mAh cell capacity, 74 Wh, under the airline limit printed on the label
65 W continuous USB-C PD output, enough for a laptop
Two USB-C ports and one USB-A port
Charges itself in about 90 min from a 65 W USB-C wall adapter
description: Capacity is 20000 mAh and 74 Wh. Output is 65 W continuous on USB-C PD. Weight is 480 g.

seller.name: Amazon
seller.raw: Ships from Amazon Sold by Amazon

reviews.title: Holds the stated capacity
reviews.body: I metered a full drain at about 68 Wh into a laptop over USB-C. The 65 W claim held until the bank hit roughly 20 percent.
reviews.author: Neel

reviews.title: Heavy, but the wattage is real
reviews.body: 480 g is noticeable in a bag. It did charge a 14 inch laptop at 65 W. The USB-A port is only for a phone.
reviews.author: Lata

reviews.title: PD handshake worked
reviews.body: My work laptop negotiated 65 W on the first USB-C port. The second port dropped to a lower wattage while both were in use, which the spec table implies.
reviews.author: Imran

reviews.title: Fanless and warm
reviews.body: After 40 minutes at 65 W the case was warm but not alarming. Capacity feels close to 20000 mAh. I wish the display showed watt-hours remaining.
reviews.author: Sana

reviews.title: USB-A is slow
reviews.body: The USB-C side is fine. A phone on the USB-A port crawled. Not a defect, just a weak port next to an otherwise specific 65 W listing.
reviews.author: Dev
